text_to_speech: the most consistent thing about every night on the tour has been how inconsistent the tour itself has been every venues different every audience is different the one thing that has stayed fairly well secure and sounding good is all the gear that I brought with me the Black Panther kit Mapex sent me one before they introduced it at the NAMM show and I was able to kind of fiddle around with it and I had been using the Saturn kit since 2004 and used a Saturn kit on all the Lamb of God albums and found really a great sound on those albums and the kind of sound where I'm asked constantly where are your drums sampled are you using triggers just really great clean quick very attack heavy drum sounds and the blaster is really an update from that it's got a higher range of tones that I found then the Saturn kit does but it still allows me to be very very quick and aggressive with the attack that I'm using and every night on the tour we have had a different kit which in in a lot of cases traveling around the world sometimes not ending up with the same kind of kit or even the same brand of kit is really a crapshoot but it's been extremely consistent even having different drums every night you know you have your drum carpet you know where things are supposed to go but that doesn't mean they always work the way they're supposed to work and every every kit that we've had so far on the tour and I anticipate till the end of the tour sounds great I'm Chris Adler I play in Lamb of God and I'm using mapex because performance is everything

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: The most consistent thing about every night on the tour has been how inconsistent the
tour itself has been.
Every venue is different, every audience is different.
The one thing that has stayed fairly well, secure and sounding good is all the gear that
I brought with me, the Black Panther kit.
Maypex sent me one before they introduced it at the NAMM show and I was able to kind of
fiddle around with it.
I had been using the Saturn kit since 2004 and used the Saturn kit on all of the Lamb of
God albums and found really a great sound on those albums.
The kind of sound where I'm asked constantly, where are your drums sampled, are you using
triggers, just really great, clean, quick, very attack heavy drum sounds.
The blasters really an update from that.
It's got a higher range of tones that I found than the Saturn kit does but it still allows
me to be very, very quick and aggressive with the attack that I'm using.
Every night on the tour we have had a different kit which in a lot of cases traveling around
the world, sometimes not ending up with the same kind of kit or even the same brand of
kit is really a crapshoot.
It's been extremely consistent even having different drums every night.
You have your drum carpet, where things are supposed to go but that doesn't mean they
always work the way they're supposed to work.
Every kit that we've had so far on the tour and I anticipate to the end of the tour sounds
great.
I'm Chris Sather, I play in Lamb of God and I'm using Maypex because performance is everything.
